arStrings.szText: Enemies hit by {c_important}Rushing Claw{/c} take {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage from {c_important}Rushing Claw{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_9}*{SF_10}*100|%x|]{/c}.
{c_important}Rushing Claw{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_25}*100|%x|]{/c} more damage if you Dodged in the last {c_number}{buffduration:SIDE_3_BUFF}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Rushing Claw{/c} extends the duration of your active {c_important}Incarnate{/c} Skills by {c_number}[{SF_27}|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds;, up to {c_number}[{SF_28}|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds;.

{c_important}Rushing Claw{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_22}*100|%|]{/c} increased damage and is empowered based on how many Charges it has when you Cast it:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}1:{/c} Heals {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_21]){/c}.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}2:{/c} Guaranteed to Critically Strike.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}3:{/c} Gain {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|%|]{/c} Dodge Chance for {c_number}[{buffduration:UPGRADE_A_DODGE}|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds;. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}4+:{/c} Strikes an additional time.

Using {c_important}Rushing Claw's{/c} last Charge will refill {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} Charges by consuming {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Rushing Claw{/c} now has {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} Maximum Charges. Casting it consumes all Charges to increase its damage by {c_number}[{SF_6}*100|%x|]{/c} per Charge and it hits a larger area.

{c_important}Rushing Claw's{/c} Cooldown refreshes {c_number}[SF_35 * 100|%|]{/c} faster for each {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} you have.

{c_important}Rushing Claw{/c} becomes an {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skill, deals Lightning damage, and has {c_number}{SF_30}{/c} Charges with a {c_number}[SF_36]{/c} second Charge Cooldown. 

You no longer need a target to Cast {c_important}Rushing Claw{/c}.
